about: What ceng-m1.1 ported into crates/calc-engine from the pinned legacy source, what it changed and why, what it left out with the beads that will need it (found by the search recorded in owner_search), and each legacy test whose expectation the port keeps, changes or drops. Only this bead writes this file.

sources.pin: migration/source-manifest.json (pin date 2026-10-15); the blob equals the pin's (git rev-parse 1bd514ef...:src/oxcalc-core/src/grid/machine/invalidation.rs in C:/Work/DnaCalc/OxCalc)

kept: a run of whole rows or whole columns, first to last inclusive, built from two positions in either order
a cell is covered when its row (or column) lies in the run (axis_value_dependency_contains_address)
a value edit to a covered cell reaches the dependent

changes.change: The interval carries its SheetId; the axis is calc-doc-model's Axis (Rows, Columns).
changes.reason: One workbook-wide graph replaces the per-sheet index, so every edge names its sheet; the authored operation vocabulary already defines the axis.

changes.change: The constructor refuses position 0 and positions past the axis with calc-value's GridError (implemented fresh).
changes.reason: The legacy validation (validate_axis_value_dependency) is outside the pinned file.

changes.change: An interval is stored as one edge per sheet and axis and matched by range, not expanded into one reverse entry per row or column.
changes.reason: Plan 6.1 and 6.2: whole rows and columns must not allocate per position.

kept: one stored edge per 3D reference, never a materialized per-sheet fan
membership is a function of the current sheet order, re-read whenever it is needed

changes.change: workbook_id, start_sheet and end_sheet strings become the first endpoint's SheetId (the target area's sheet) and the last endpoint's SheetId; the target text becomes a GridArea.
changes.reason: Integer IDs in one workbook graph; reference text is CalcFml's to bind.

changes.change: A value edit to a covered cell seeds the span's dependent; membership is read from the input snapshot's sheet order (SheetSpan::sheets borrows the snapshot's slice).
changes.reason: The legacy returned no seed for a span (grid_dirty_seed_for_dependency) because its intra-sheet layer could not see sheet order; the one graph can, and a dropped seed would leave the dependent stale.

ported.symbol: reverse range indexing (GridDependencyIndex: dependents_by_cell, compressed_range_dependents_by_block, axis_value_dependents_by_index, set_cell_dependencies, remove_existing_dependencies, direct_dependents_for_cell, compressed_range_dependents_containing)
kept: a range is one compressed edge filed in fixed blocks and checked for containment at query time
setting a dependent's dependencies replaces the ones it had and refiles them
a cell's direct dependents are the union of its cell, range and axis-value dependents

changes.change: Dependents are NodeIds, not cell addresses, and there is one index for the workbook instead of one per sheet; the owning-sheet check (ForeignSheetDependency) is gone.
changes.reason: Interned node IDs in one graph whose edges may cross sheets (the bead's Do).

changes.change: Block sizes (256 rows by 64 columns), the per-sheet wide list for a rectangle covering more than 64 blocks, and the area query over a sheet's rectangles are implemented fresh.
changes.reason: The legacy block helpers live in optimized_sheet.rs, which is not a pinned input of this bead.

changes.change: Small ranges are not scalarized into cell edges (no scalarization limit).
changes.reason: One edge per range is enough for the queries this bead needs; performance tuning is out of scope.

changes.change: Prerequisites name sheets that must be in the input snapshot; coordinate bounds are already checked by calc-value's CellKey and GridArea.
changes.reason: The engine reads sheet identities from the snapshot it is given, not from a stamped owning sheet.

changes.change: Only direct dependents are computed, and they are staged on prepare_edit's InputSeed for each cell whose authored input the batch changes (compared with the base snapshot's page) and for each clear that empties a cell, listing the readers of the cells the clear empties, without the nodes the same batch replaces or removes.
changes.reason: Dirty closure and ordering are ceng-m1.2's.

not_ported.beads_basis: the pin lists invalidation.rs and spill_ledger.rs with these symbols for ceng-m3.4; its Do ports spill ownership and blocker concepts
ceng-m3.2's Do: names as definition/lookup nodes, rename and undefined-to-defined transitions
ceng-m3.3's Do: observed read footprints and dynamic edges
ceng-m3.1's Do names a metadata facet
ceng-m1.2's Do: compute dirty closure and a deterministic topological ready queue
ceng-m4.1's Do: update coordinate-to-node maps and dependency descriptors from prepared structural patches
ceng-m3.7's and ceng-m4.6's Do: external snapshots and external/RTD/async operations

items: axis visibility reverse index and its seeds
not_ported.beads_basis: ceng-m3.1's Do names a visibility facet; ceng-m3.5's names row-visibility facets for SUBTOTAL/AGGREGATE; WorkbookOp has no operation that hides or shows rows or columns, so nothing in this bead would index or read the facet
diagnostic reports: ceng-m4.5's Do returns typed recalc facts and counts; ceng-m7.1's compares dependency footprints between strategies

owner_search.rule: Each not_ported item was matched to the beads the pin lists for invalidation.rs (ceng-m1.1, ceng-m3.1, ceng-m3.2, ceng-m3.3, ceng-m3.4, ceng-m3.5, ceng-m3.8, ceng-m4.1, ceng-m5.1, ceng-m5.6) and to the Do sentence of every ceng bead in docs/plan/BEAD_DETAILS.md that names the item's concept (spill, name, table, dynamic/observed reads, metadata, dirty closure/ready queue, SCC, structural patches, volatile/effect tapes, external/RTD, visibility facets, recalc facts, differential comparison).

beads_not_assigned.ceng-m3.8: derived participants (charts, pivots) use no legacy symbol of this file
beads_not_assigned.ceng-m5.6: conditional-formatting applicability uses no legacy symbol of this file beyond the range index ported here

witness_search.rule: Every #[test] function at the pinned commit (every .rs file of OxCalc at 1bd514ef, by git ls-tree -r) whose own body names, as a whole word, a ported symbol of invalidation.rs or one the bead's Port from names, or that calls a function of its own #[cfg(test)] module whose body names one. The symbols: GridAxisValueDependency and GridSheetSpanDependency (ported), GridDependencyIndex (ported reverse range indexing; private to invalidation.rs, so tests reach it through GridInvalidationRef, which owns it), GridInvalidationRef, and GridAxisVisibilityDependency (named by the bead, not ported). Each found test's assertions were read to give its disposition.

It asserts that the per-sheet coordinator's state types, GridInvalidationRef among them, are Send. No case of this bead asserts that EngineState is Send, and no ceng bead names Send, Sync or threads except ceng-m7.1's single-threaded reference strategy (search: the words Send, Sync and thread in the title and description of every ceng bead of docs/plan/beads.br.jsonl).
The one graph has no intra-sheet layer: a value edit inside a span's current membership seeds its dependent, and a sheet outside it in the current order does not.

Endpoints are SheetIds and the target a GridArea rather than strings; the BTreeSet-ordering part is dropped because GridArea has no total order and the graph stores spans in its own ordered edge type.
